description: Parking — Clearways is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset is a linear representation of where clearways exist along stretches of road in the Brisbane City Council local government area. Clearways improve traffic flow during peak times and improve public safety. You must not set down or pick up passengers in clearways, even when stopped at traffic lights or in traffic. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Administration and Operations. Its keywords are arcgis, administration and operations, roads traffic and parking, parking, transport. The portal shows 648 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
